notes.title: Version 0.6.8 notes for 20th of May update
notes.notes:
Nice quality of life combo gameplay updates today:
- added grace period timer to landing mid combo so you have 0.5 seconds to jump and trick or manual in case you didn't trigger the manual on time in the air before landing (this can currently be kept going forever by jumping over and over and over which will be addressed next)
- grace period timer is also activated when you switch back to skating from walking mid combo, so you have 0.5 seconds to manual or jump and grind etc.
- this is displayed on the HUD as a new blue counter that appears next to the combo count, thanks MattCantu on our Discord for the feedback about adding grace periods
- also added repeat rail counters and thresholds, so now during your combo hitting a rail repeatedly doesn't start giving balance penalty until after the 3rd repeat
- this is displayed on the HUD with the "new rail" / "repeat rail" notification, repeat rail lists the number and turns red after 3, thanks Ted00 on our Discord for the sentiments

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 0.6.2 notes for 13th of May update 2
notes.notes:
- fixed all time high combo saving, had some bugs
- greatly increased incremental balance trick score increase
- manuals / nose manuals now get 14 points per 50ms, up from 3 points per 50ms
- grinds and slides now get 10 points per 50ms, up from 1 point per 50ms
- fixed revert friction
- full revert friction is only applied when holding a powerslide (L2+R2), rolling or manual
- only 0.2 revert friction is applied when reverting or pivoting, so you can use it to re-orient or for style without sacrificing speed
- revert friction now also properly applies orientation multiplier, ie: more friction the more sideways you are

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 0.5.9 notes for 11th of May update
notes.notes:
fixed:
- manual to walk killing combo
- wallride to grind killing combo
- landing manual mid pivot incorrectly adding manual + pivot + nose manual to trick history

updates:
- spin logging moved from completion of auto pivot/revert to moment of land, land manual, and land grind
- spins add to score now (180 = 200, 270 = 300, 360 = 400) but not combo
- revert and pivot now logged and scored on held input past 90 degrees instead of completion of auto spin
- revert and pivot now each score 200 and add to combo
- retrick rail balance speed difficulty increase has been increased by 30% 
- retrick rail now also bumps current rail balance by 10 degrees away from zero if less than 10 degrees from bail
- new rail balance speed difficulty healing has been increased by 30%
- new rail now also heals rail balance 10 degrees toward zero if greater than 15 away from zero

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 0.4.8 notes for 1st of May update
notes.notes:
Balance Trick Update:
- input is acceleration based now so there is more weight and less twitchiness
- balance difficulty scaling persists across combo now (doesn't reset every balance trick withing combo anymore)
- manual, nose manual, grinds, and slides all have their own balance difficulty scaling across the combo
- grinding and sliding new rails that you haven't touched yet within a combo "heals" (slightly reduces) the current balance difficulty scaling for that trick type within the combo
- switching to walk mid combo also "heals" (slightly reduces) the current balance difficulty scaling for manual and nose manual within the combo

Combo Scoring Update:
- combos now track tricks
- repeated tricks in a combo degrade 20% point value
- rotations no longer increase combo
- manual to rotate to nose manual no longer increases combo

Levels:
- minor outside line tweaks on skatepark 02

Thanks for playing!
